title: QSCI noise robustness at 20 qubits (H10)
mechanism: Quantum device only selects determinants by sampling frequency; energy = exact classical diagonalization in the fixed-size (R=2200) subspace. Frequency selection filters noise-induced spurious determinants.
findings: Chemical accuracy (1.51 mHa) reached at 20q with 2e6 shots (realistic for QSCI).
Graceful degradation under depolarizing noise: at 30% corruption, still ~3.3 mHa (no catastrophic failure).
Robustness mechanism (frequency-based determinant selection) demonstrated, not just asserted.
caveat: Reaching chemical accuracy needs ~2e6 shots, reflecting H10's long correlation tail; the noise-aware point is the graceful degradation.
